deviations_from_card: FIRST PAINT drove the shape. modules/voice/live.ts, model.ts and audio.ts are in Main's first-paint root chunk (shared by the voice depth and chores/adopt), so the card's code as written (listMicrophones in lib/voice, micView/chooseMic/state in model+live) measured +704 B over HEAD+stage (165,181 B) against ~230 B headroom. Remedy: a NEW file apps/desktop/src/modules/voice/mic.ts (listMicrophones, micView, peakDb/silentTake, the LIVE_MIC row/list seam, and a tiny choice store: micChoice/refreshMics/chooseMic/subscribeMics/micState). live.ts loads it with import(), and only pieces.tsx imports it statically. It imports neither lib/voice (the level floor is passed in; that import re-split lib/voice, +550 B) nor React (the useSyncExternalStore hook lives in pieces.tsx; importing React re-split the React chunks, +242 B). So chooseMic is mic.ts's chooseMic, not useVoiceSetup.actions.chooseMic, and the choice is not in HearState/VoiceModel. Case 5 asserts the seam's write instead of settingWrite (LIVE_MIC.write calls settingWrite(SETTING_KEYS.voiceInput, id ?? '') under a shell). micView, listMicrophones and silentTake live in mic.ts, not lib/voice.ts or model.ts. openMicrophone falls back on any failure of the exact device, not only OverconstrainedError (bytes); the default's refusal is what's thrown. Push-to-talk reads the row just before openMic, not alongside the capture (bytes). TakeRecorder.start takes a device or a promise of one, so a stop before the read still waits for the open. Final first paint is 165,402 B, 10 B under the 165,412 B ceiling (+221 B over HEAD+stage). Guard case 8 was red before only on the new API (session.fellBack, openMic receiving null); its constraint/start-frame half passed before.
